name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending the Focus Points that the Hand of Healing would otherwise require. In addition, when you use Flurry of Blows, you can expend 1 Focus Point to use Hand of Harm once during that Flurry of Blows, without the Hand of Harm requiring its own Focus Point expenditure.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
